purpose: Observed physical scheduler state for the intended 19-role O scheduled-Chat Phase-1 pool. Repository logical enablement and physical scheduler state remain distinct.

platform_observation.cause_evidence: Control9 observed 19/19 at 16:28:43+09:00. A fresh live scheduler inventory at 17:38:32+09:00 found six intended enabled_desired roles stopped. Re-enable-only updates to those same task ids succeeded and a second live inventory showed 19/19. Inspected durable role evidence does not establish an authorized Phase-1 completion or pool-reduction event; do not infer the actor or exact lifecycle cause without direct evidence.

hard_gate.remaining_reason: Repeated physical-stop recurrence is now a scheduler reliability blocker, and current-control 19-role execution plus Work-dependency-elimination, zero-residual/zero-quota/cost, rate-limit, conflict/authority/usefulness gates still require durable independent evidence.

readback_policy: Supersede only with a newer live platform inventory. If any intended role stops again, cause-check and re-enable only that same existing enabled_desired task; never lower the 19-role denominator. Repository file mutation itself does not change physical scheduler state; the six re-enables were separate control-plane actions with live readback.
